verdict.rationale: Adyen Issuing explicitly supports transaction rules that automatically approve/decline authorizations based on defined logic, plus a broader webhook system (Configuration, Payment method, Transfer, Dispute, Negative balance warning, Report) that lets users react to events, and relayed authorization with configurable fallback logic on timeout. This directly matches 'define rules that trigger actions automatically on events.' Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration beyond vendor docs, and evidence of rule actions beyond approve/decline (e.g., broader custom automation workflows).
